senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. יָרַק) [to be bright, clear; cmp. לָבָן,] to be blank, empty.
to empty, pour from vessel to vessel.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3:1">Cant. R. to I, 3</cite> (ref. to <he>תורק</he> <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3:1">ib.</cite>) <he>כאדם שמֵרִיק מכלי וכ׳</he> like one emptying (perfumed oil) from one vessel into another.

<cite ref="Nedarim 32a">Ned. 32ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>וירק</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 14:14">Gen. XIV, 14</cite>) <he>הֵרִיקָן מן התורה</he> Var. (v. Tosaf. a. l.) he made them empty of study (took the scholars away from their studies to make them go to war), v. <cite ref="J00653"><he>יָרַק</he></cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18:1">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>ומריקה את הכסף</he>, read: <he>ומריצה</he>, v. <cite ref="T00427"><he>רוּץ</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to be emptied, be poured from vessel to vessel.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3:7">Lev. R. s. 3</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 1:3">Cant. I, 3</cite>, v. supra) <he>כשמן המוּרָק וכ׳</he> like oil that is poured from vessel to vessel without a sound.
